title: Encounter Composition, Challenge, Resource & Pacing Advisory
objective: Extend the prepared MAS Adventure workspace with deterministic Encounter Composition, Challenge, Resource and Pacing Advisory over the MAS-01..09 foundations while preserving canonical Encounter/combat/challenge/resource/runtime owner authority and keeping advisory planning distinct from live resolution or mutation.

scope.purpose: Represent prepared Encounter Composition, Challenge, Resource and Pacing Advisory inside the MAS workspace without turning advisory composition into canonical encounter state, live challenge resolution, resource mutation or runtime outcome truth.
scope.completion_gate: A representative MAS workspace can deterministically produce prepared encounter/challenge/resource/pacing advisory over the completed MAS foundations with explicit references and fail-closed invalid states while preserving canonical owner/runtime authority and never treating advisory planning as executed live truth.

selection_boundaries: MAS-01 through MAS-09 remain completed foundations and were not reopened.

Encounter composition, Challenge, Resource and Pacing structures remain prepared advisory semantics only; A7/Encounter retains encounter lifecycle authority, A7/A9 and owning domains retain challenge resolution, inventory-equipment/owning domains retain resource state, and Action/Event/runtime owner domains retain occurrence, outcomes and canonical mutation authority.
Prepared encounter/challenge/resource/pacing advice never proves encounter start/completion, challenge resolution, resource spending/recovery or runtime outcome truth.
MAS-10 consumed explicit MAS-09 prepared references and validated Encounter owner bindings; unresolved references fail closed.
MAS-10 introduced no universal challenge formula, universal resource formula, wall-clock timer, scheduler, initiative tracker, parallel resource ledger or runtime outcome ledger.
Existing MAS validation family remained active; no family transition occurred in MAS-10.
ROADMAP_DEPENDENCY_GRAPH.json was reconsulted after MAS-10, including current MSLR planning; no new cross-program rotation is unlocked, so MAS-11 is selected_not_started.
CNI-12 and PCA remain unselected; MAS-12+ and SMB-08 were not implemented by this tranche.
next_action: MAS-10 is closed. MAS-11 is selected_not_started after ROADMAP_DEPENDENCY_GRAPH reconciliation and requires a later owner Continue before governed start.
